title: Life skills at school
prompt: Schools should teach students how to manage money and solve everyday problems alongside academic subjects. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

title: Repairing household products
prompt: Manufacturers should be required to make household products easy for customers to repair. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

title: Cars in city centres
prompt: Private cars should be banned from city centres during the busiest hours of the day. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

title: Museums and free admission
prompt: All publicly funded museums should offer free admission to visitors. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

title: Food waste in supermarkets
prompt: Supermarkets should be required to donate food that is still safe to eat but cannot be sold. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

title: Advertising aimed at children
prompt: Companies should not be allowed to advertise products directly to children under the age of twelve. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

title: Public access to university research
prompt: The results of publicly funded university research should be available online for anyone to read free of charge. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

title: Shorter working weeks
prompt: Employers should offer a four-day working week without reducing employees' pay. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

title: Housing near public transport
prompt: Local authorities should prioritise building new homes near public transport stations. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

title: Learning an additional language
prompt: All students should learn an additional language until they finish secondary school. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
